en-US.shortDescription: Keep a private log of what matters to you, like sleep, workouts or moods, and hear it back by voice.
en-US.fullDescription: Bookshelf Vault is your private, structured journal. Define what you track once, then log entries hands-free: say what happened, hear it read back, and confirm before anything is saved. Ask what you track, what a category records, your recent entries, or how much of your plan you use. Answers are short and come five at a time. Your entries belong to your account only; nothing is shared unless you choose to share it from the vault itself.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Bookshelf Vault what I'm tracking.
Alexa, ask Bookshelf Vault to log seven and a half hours of sleep.
Alexa, ask Bookshelf Vault for my sleep entries from this week.
Alexa, ask Bookshelf Vault how much of my plan I've used.
